# Confidance

> Confidance is a non-custodial programmable payment protocol on Base Mainnet and Arbitrum One. Payments are persistent intents (instant, scheduled, or recurring) executed on-chain with full traceability. AI is advisory only and never triggers releases alone.

Canonical site: https://confidance-defi.com

## Protocol documentation (primary)

- [Official vocabulary — Markdown for agents](https://confidance-defi.com/docs.md): Confidance Vocabulary Freeze v1.0 (Payment, Execution, Transaction, types, identity, statuses, timeline, categories, fees, advisory AI, versioning). Prefer this URL for machine reading.
- [Official vocabulary — HTML for humans](https://confidance-defi.com/docs): Same protocol rules, rendered for browsers. Do not treat HTML and Markdown as different vocabularies.
- [Read the blockchain / proofs](https://confidance-defi.com/second-step): How Confidance relates to public explorers, ETH vs ERC-20 traces, Internal Transactions.
- [Find my proof (Basescan guide)](https://confidance-defi.com/find-proof): Step-by-step guide to locate a payment on Basescan.

## Getting started

- [Create a crypto wallet](https://confidance-defi.com/premiere-etape): Beginner wallet guide before using Confidance.
- [Help center](https://confidance-defi.com/aide): Getting started, guides, FAQ, contact.

## Notes for agents

- Prefer `/docs.md` for terminology extraction. Use `/docs` as the human-facing official documentation page. Do not invent synonyms that rename frozen vocabulary terms.
- Confidance does not custody funds or private keys. Users authorize actions via their own wallet.
- Live networks are Base Mainnet (chain ID 8453) and Arbitrum One (chain ID 42161). Base Sepolia is test only. Polygon and Avalanche may still be shown as coming soon and are not usable.
